scenario_registry.requirement: Typed capability/Mission/Candidate/Expected/history groups, actual zero/one/multiple active work and no phantom Mission allocation
Frozen revision, distinct approvals, manual/automatic release, eligibility and active lifecycle remain orthogonal
M2 genuinely approved/released through real services before M1; current dependency evidence unlocks M2 once without owner relay
Expected or partially/unapproved Candidate never auto-starts; new Candidate still follows explicit real approvals
Predecessor COMPLETE without required artifact/review/deployment evidence does not unlock dependent work
Expiry, revocation, hold or policy change between eligibility and claim denies activation at the actual boundary
Routine source change revalidates assumptions without blanket reapproval; material scope change cannot reuse stale approvals
Priority and hard/speculative edges remain distinct; conflicting/cyclic/unresolved edge edits rejected; stable eligible tie-break
Duplicate/out-of-order completion and event delivery produce one reconciliation/context application and correct delta
Concurrent starters and lost acknowledgement preserve one activation/intake identity; uncertain EP POST is not resubmitted
Fresh process reopens pending, claimed, admitted and reconciled boundaries with same instance, authority and consumption
Cursor resync, mixed revisions, pagination, offline and source outage remain visibly stale/partial; stale command rejected
EP completion, Forge reconciliation and required human acceptance are independently represented
Expected added/split/merged/retired changes retain reasons and provenance; no silent overwrite of human/frozen work
Wrong project/actor/instance, confused-deputy requests, malicious content and secret-bearing links are denied/redacted
Read-only report and docs/design-only scope survive projection, successor and release; no automatic implementation expansion
Supported serial/concurrent limits preserved; unsupported multiplicity visible, no newly enabled parallel execution
Unknown estimates/usage/confidence remain unknown; no progress from changing Mission counts or invented deadline
Five locales, both themes, desktop/phone, keyboard/touch, stable detail links, selection and clipboard failures
Refresh/sort/open/reconnect issues zero planning, intake or EP mutation requests; closing Workspace does not stop Forge
Versioned hold/disarm/reorder/release commands show preview and actual readback; paused Forge does not cancel admitted EP work
Failed/ambiguous predecessor never grants new authority or fresh repair budget under a replacement Mission
Missing API/capability or peer outage has no CLI/import/SQL/Inbox/IPC fallback; read-only rollout labels unsupported controls
No remaining project gap yields bounded idle and no fabricated Expected/Candidate/Mission or extra provider call
